description: Copilot-replica inline autocomplete using your own API endpoint, configured entirely in VS Code Settings. Works alongside GitHub Copilot.
configuration.title: Dspilot
configuration.completion.enabled.descrip: Enable copilot-replica inline autocomplete. A model must be configured before requests are sent. GitHub Copilot is not disabled.
configuration.completion.baseUrl.descrip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, including any `/v1` prefix. Examples: `https://api.openai.com/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1`. The plugin appends `/completions` or `/chat/completions` automatically. Configure in User Settings only.
configuration.completion.apiKey.descript: API key for the completion endpoint. Leave blank for anonymous local APIs. **Stored in plain text in User Settings and excluded from Settings Sync.** Never put a real key in workspace files or source control.
configuration.completion.model.descripti: Autocomplete model ID. Leave empty to make no API requests. For native FIM, use a code completion model such as Qwen Coder Base rather than an Instruct/chat model.
configuration.completion.apiType.descrip: API protocol for FIM autocomplete. This does not change the copilot-replica algorithm.
configuration.completion.apiType.complet: Native OpenAI-compatible /completions API using a FIM prompt.
configuration.completion.apiType.chat-co: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions API with a code-completion prompt for chat models.
configuration.completion.fimTemplate.des: FIM prompt format supported by the chosen model. These are prompt templates, not different autocomplete algorithms.
configuration.completion.maxTokens.descr: Maximum output tokens for each FIM autocomplete request.
Maximum FIM candidates requested when explicitly cycling suggestions. Automatic completion uses one candidate.
configuration.completion.temperature.des: Sampling temperature. Zero is recommended for deterministic autocomplete.
configuration.completion.timeoutMs.descr: Maximum duration of an API request, including streamed responses, in milliseconds.
configuration.completion.extraHeaders.de: Additional API request headers. Values may use ${APIKEY}. Sensitive header values are stored in User Settings and are not synchronized.
configuration.completion.extraBody.descr: Additional API body parameters. Required model, prompt/messages, streaming and output-limit fields are managed by the plugin.
configuration.completion.disabledGlobs.d: Additional file globs where autocomplete is disabled. Built-in sensitive-file exclusions always remain active.
configuration.completion.enabledLanguage: Enable autocomplete by VS Code language ID. Use * for the default, for example {"*": true, "markdown": false}.
configuration.completion.respectSelected: Account for the selected IntelliSense suggestion when producing autocomplete.
configuration.completion.nes.enabled.des: Enable copilot-replica next-edit suggestions in addition to FIM. Requires an edit-capable model and the `inlineCompletionsAdditions` Proposed API. Ordinary autocomplete still works when that API is unavailable.
configuration.completion.nes.model.descr: Optional next-edit model ID. Empty uses the autocomplete model. Uses the same API base URL and API key via /chat/completions.
configuration.completion.nes.maxTokens.d: Maximum output tokens for a next-edit request.
configuration.completion.nes.cursorPredi: Enable next-cursor-line prediction for a model trained to support it. Leave disabled for general-purpose models.
configuration.completion.nes.eagerness.d: Next-edit suggestion aggressiveness within the copilot-replica algorithm.
configuration.completion.nes.strategy.de: Next-edit prompt format expected by the configured model. Does not select another algorithm.
configuration.verbose.description: Enable diagnostic autocomplete logs. API keys and source-code prompts are never logged.
configuration.completion.fimTemplate.suf: Native `prompt` + `suffix` request fields (DeepSeek /beta, OpenAI-style FIM). Only with API type `completions`.
configuration.completion.debounceMs.desc: Quiet period in milliseconds to wait after typing before sending an automatic request. Requests cancelled during this window are never sent. Set 0 to disable. Cache hits and manual triggers are not delayed.
